name: Grieving Carved Mourner OLD
source: Pathfinder Society Special #3-98: Expedition Into Pallid Peril
description: The carving weeps. Its tears turn to a mist that covers the halls.
disable: DC 23 Religion (trained) to recite prayers for the dead, or dwarven-lore|dc:20 to speak the history of Raseri Kanton, or DC 26 Thievery (trained) to plug the holes in the carving
reset: The trap resets whenever a creature enters the Labyrinth for the first time.

generalAbilities.name: Weep for Raseri Kanton
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature looks at the carved mourner

Effect The hallways fill with a thick mist. When the mist first appears, all living creatures in area A take 3d6 Void Damage damage (Basic DC 20 Fortitude Saving Throw save), and all undead creatures regain 3d6 Healing Damage Hit Points. All creatures within the mist become Concealed. This mist lasts for 1 hour or until the haunt is disabled.
